selected_problem: Fresh main WorkspaceService.manifest consumed fs.readdirSync order directly. Under a bounded maxFiles cap, equivalent directory contents exposed in a different valid filesystem enumeration order produced a different observed manifest and therefore could change the semantic seed context.
route_basis: The defect is singular and reality-reproduced at the fresh-main observation boundary. Stable per-directory name ordering removes enumeration-order bias without choosing a new large-repository sampling architecture or forcing a mode rotation.
change: Sort each observed directory entry list by entry name before the existing recursive bounded manifest walk.
truth_boundary: This makes the existing bounded depth-first manifest deterministic for equivalent directory contents. It does not claim exhaustive large-repository coverage, an optimal sampling policy, parser-grade module semantics, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
